name: Onosaka Hikaru
source: [url=/c24581]Ichigo's[/url] good friend and the photographer of the newspaper club. People often tease him because of his cute appearance, calling him cuter than any of the school's girls; even when he wears the guys' uniform, the girls think he is actually just a tomboy. Despite this, Hikaru is a very hardworking boy who does his best to impress his upperclassmen at the newspaper club.
